data.body: [P1] This caller-side `finish.run()` races with the earlier `handlerFuture.whenComplete(...)` even when cleanup finishes within budget. The waiter can wake before the completion action claims `started`, causing all `onInvocationEnd` hooks—including unannotated legacy plugins in a mixed OTel configuration—to run on the invocation caller. A legacy plugin cannot then clear `ThreadLocal` state installed by `onInvocationStart`, leaking it into the reused handler worker. Let the registered completion action exclusively finalize successful handoffs, and invoke `finish` from the caller only after an actual timeout or interruption; add a suspended mixed-plugin reused-worker regression test.
